title: Orange Lane: rapid consolidation and scoping template for high-touch enterprise feature asks
creator: Marisol Gomez
description: Problem: Sales and CS field teams are receiving bursts of overlapping feature asks from a small set of enterprise accounts. Current intake routes create duplicated work, unclear priority, and long discovery cycles for high-touch customers. Goal: Create a compact, repeatable 'Orange Lane' consolidation and initial-scoping template that Sales/CS can run in 1-2 hours with the customer (or in an internal intake call) to produce a single-scoped ask, initial success metrics, and an estimated sizing bucket for PM/Eng. This ticket scopes the template, tooling hooks, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for a pilot with three strategic accounts.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A one-page Orange Lane template is published in Confluence and linked from the CS intake playbook.

A2: Sales/CS can run the template in <=90 minutes and produce a 3-field summary: (1) consolidated problem statement, (2) top-3 success metrics, (3) sizing bucket (small/medium/large) with example acceptance thresholds.
A3: PMs can map the output to an initial priority score (0-10) using the new account-priority rubric.
A4: Instrumentation hooks (a short Google Form + an internal intake label in Linear) are created so every Orange Lane run produces a traceable item with links to artifacts and decision notes.
A5: Pilot completed with 3 accounts and reduction of duplicate asks reported (target >=50% consolidation) documented in pilot retro.
A6: Template includes explicit escalation path for security/compliance blockers that requires a security review flag.
A7: Training deck and 30-minute onboarding session for CS is delivered and scheduled.
A8: Metrics dashboard query and simple Looker tile are defined to track throughput, consolidation rate, and avg intake time.
A9: Ownership: PM (Marisol Gomez) owns template; Sales Ops owns rollout; Eng liaison assigned for sizing guidance (Liam Chen).
steps: 1) Draft one-page Orange Lane template (problem, context, success metrics, constraints, suggested solution direction, sizing heuristics) — PM.
2) Align with Sales Ops and 2 senior CS reps on language and fields; iterate with real examples from accounts A, B, C.
3) Create a lightweight Google Form to capture template outputs with a required field for links to supporting docs and account priority.
4) Add a Linear intake label 'orange-lane' and a triage checklist in the Linear project; update owners.
5) Build a 30-minute training deck and run two live sessions with CS pilot group.
6) Run pilot for 4-6 weeks with 3 accounts; collect metrics and feedback; iterate template.
7) Post-pilot: roll forward to broader Sales/CS, publish Confluence page, and add a Console dashboard tile for monitoring.
8) Debrief with Eng to map common asks into sizing buckets and create a mapping doc for Eng estimations.
decision_points: DP1: Template must be executable in a single customer call — if clarity requires >90 minutes, we will split into 'Orange Lane + Deep-Dive' flows.
DP2: Sizing buckets will be coarse (small/medium/large) with example anchors rather than story point estimates to keep CS time low.
DP3: Security-critical asks should be flagged and routed to Security review — we will require a security_review_required flag in the intake form.
DP4: Pilot accounts chosen should represent diversity in product usage (one embeddings-heavy, one chat-heavy, one dedicated capacity customer).
artifact_links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4421 (planned Linear automation to tag orange-lane items)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sales/CS may skip steps and submit partial output. Mitigation: required form fields + mandatory training for pilot reps.
Risk: Template produces too many 'large' buckets overwhelming Eng. Mitigation: tighten anchors and add explicit trade-off examples; add Eng pre-triage channel.
Risk: Sensitive customer asks require compliance sign-off. Mitigation: include escalation path and require security flag for PII/KMS concerns.
metrics_to_track: Pilot_success: % reduction in duplicate asks per account
Number of intake items flagged for security
